scope: 2026 Victorian state election · official nomination totals and voting timetable

sources.label: VEC official nomination totals, 10 November 2026
sources.note: 1,037 nominations: 734 Assembly and 303 Council. Ballot draws took place for all 88 districts and eight regions.

sources.label: VEC official candidates by district and region
sources.note: Follow the link for your district or region for candidates in ballot paper order.

sources.label: VEC voting options and opening hours
sources.note: Early voting in Victoria is 9 am to 6 pm, 18 to 27 November, with centres closed on Sunday 22 November.

observations.scope: All 96 official district and region lists. Published ballot names, order, affiliations and Council groups were verified. Existing P4A announcement records retain their dates.
